## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* alternative sectional analysis (*kē* 科) of Zhànrán's *Jīngāngbēi* ([KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175), T1932) by **Gūshān Zhìyuán** 孤山智圓 (976–1022) — one of the principal *shānwài* spokespersons alongside Rényuè ([仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3)). The work is parallel to Rényuè's *Kē* ([KR6d0177](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0177)); together they constitute the principal *shānwài* tradition's navigational apparatus on the *Jīngāngbēi*.

**Abstract**

Zhìyuán's *Kē* and *Xiǎnxìng lù* ([KR6d0179](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0179)) together constitute the principal *shānwài* commentarial apparatus on the *Jīngāngbēi*, providing the *shānwài* alternative interpretation of Zhànrán's doctrine of the buddha-nature of insentient beings. The composition is bracketed within Zhìyuán's productive period c. 996–1022.
